title: Aira Velakku Thittam (Iron Lantern Scheme) — New Nation-Wide Safety Initiative
author: Office of the President
summary: Former President Adolfo's proposed Aira Velakku Thittam was unanimously approved at the 27th World Nations Assembly, with a Memorandum of Cooperation signed with Kasukabey. The scheme installs lighting in vulnerable areas nationwide to reduce nighttime hostile-mob threats (Creepers, Skeletons, Zombies), protecting citizens and infrastructure. President Rolex5834 has reaffirmed the policy.

title: Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) Officially Implemented
author: Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research
summary: Following five years of astronomical and chronometric research, the National Astronomical Observation Institute confirmed the calendar in use since the world's founding (23 April 2021) suffered systematic drift. With National Assembly approval and Presidential authorization, the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) is now the Republic's sole official timekeeping system; prior records are preserved under the Old Calendar Records (OCR) designation, and all future government orders, laws, elections, treaties, and press releases must use UBC notation.

title: Presidential Report on the Plague Period, the Isolation of Nations, Earth Journeys and the State of Binod World
author: Office of the President
summary: Issued in Tamil. Reports on the plague period (03.07.2026 to 09.08.2026), when all nations of Binod World were isolated from one another; the Port Mafia leader Mr. Franky boy's journey to Earth World, including Kerala, to study sea-port and logistics facilities; a human-resources recruitment meeting in Kasukabey; a large antenna project in Bavaria based on BIASR research; a new satellite launched, with usage rights already given to Port Mafia, which has not yet fully used it; the world completing its 110th year on day 40,027 of the Binod calendar; and the President's apology for delays in public information.

title: Announcement on Research Progress, the RIDD Organisation, VANTA, and the Proposed BINOVA and ERPA
author: Official Information Publication Division, Binod World Government
summary: Issued in Tamil. States that no new presidential election has been held since 19.08.2026 and that no new administration has been formed. Reports that BIASR continues its science work and that Port Mafia leader Mr. Franky boy has travelled to Earth World with another life-form; announces that RIDD (Research, Intelligence, Investigation and Defense), introduced by Mr. Rolex5834, is now operational; introduces VANTA, a search engine for Binod World; and records that BINOVA (a higher-education and research institute) and ERPA (the Education Rights Protection Authority), both proposed by Mr. Adolfo, are still proposals without the President's official approval.
